name: Ultron
description: Standalone autonomous Pokemon robot rivals with legitimate progression, optional player companionship, companion-only double battles, independent companion battle AI, persistent chronicles, competitive memory, and optional integration with The World.

Companion double-battle engine adapted from Double Battles v0.6.1 by shanehudson-gen1recomp-mods. Offline Smogon Gen 1/Gen 2 competitive snapshot retained with attribution in docs/SMOGON_DATA_NOTICE.md.
